import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook

root = Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('export_r27', root / 'scripts/export-fidelity-progress-r27.py')
exporter = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(exporter)
expected = load_workbook(root / 'docs/BOW_FIDELITE_R27.xlsx')
actual = load_workbook(root / 'qa-fidelity-r27-ci/BOW_FIDELITE_R27.xlsx')
try:
    assert actual.sheetnames == expected.sheetnames
    for name in expected.sheetnames:
        assert exporter.worksheet_state(actual[name]) == exporter.worksheet_state(expected[name]), name
    result = {'reproduced_sheets': len(expected.sheetnames), 'progress_bytes_equal': True,
              'scope': 'Values, formulas, styles, links, comments, merged cells and frozen panes; ZIP timestamps excluded.'}
    (root / 'qa-fidelity-r27-ci/workbook-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
finally:
    actual.close()
    expected.close()
